## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; strong sector participation but mixed leadership and major tech divergences (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META showing short-term weakness) confirm a neutral, wait-for-confirmation environment.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Industrials lead: LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND. Energy/Materials showing cyclical strength with SLB (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%) ABOVE TREND and NUE (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -0.17%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials); Style: Value/Cyclical tilted.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Consumer Discretionary mixed with TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND and AMZN (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +1.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND; RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND; T (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials) indicating concentrated cyclical strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -8.99% | 1M: +8.27%) TREND EXHAUSTION; META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION; AMZN (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +1.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Weakness concentrated in select high-multiple tech and communication names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: GM (1W: +14.42%), LMT (1W: +13.83%), RTX (1W: +12.33%); watch NUE (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -0.17%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL for short-term follow-through. Major divergence: several large caps (MSFT, NVDA, META, AMZN) display 1W vs 1M mismatch — treat moves as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed/under pressure: GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Sector breadth: 1/11 sectors negative (Technology the lone laggard) — internal rotation within tech; monitor large-cap leadership for confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady and constructive: JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth supportive and complements cyclical leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing strength: JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND. Defensive/earnings-driven names confirming positive news flow and price action.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to cyclical/value leaders in Industrials and Energy (LMT, RTX, SLB, XOM) while reducing exposure to concentrated, short-term weak large-cap tech positions (GOOGL, INTC, parts of semis). Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, stay selective and wait for tech confirmation before adding big-cap growth weight.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION, GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +4.45% | 15 stocks) and Energy (1W: +1.06% | 10 stocks) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.32% | 24 stocks) — monitor for spillover into growth leadership.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch AAPL (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent highs; NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION — failure to reclaim 1M momentum is a downside trigger; JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND — sustained strength would confirm cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+60): JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND — settlement/news confirmed by price strength. VZ (+55): VZ (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND — upgraded outlook and price appreciation aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVDA (-55): NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION — negative headlines coinciding with short-term selling, divergence vs mild 1M gain. INTC (-55): INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirming downside; CAT (-45): CAT (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -17.23%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — negative supply-chain headlines warrant monitoring despite small 1W bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt given narrow industrial leadership and broad sector participation (Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive). Industrials and Energy showing relative strength — LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: major tech divergence (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) and mixed sentiment on NVDA/INTC — watch for trend confirmation before increasing growth exposure.
